standard.summary: 冻结基座权重压缩预设
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.experimental_float8: 主干 FP8，偏 40 系，实验味。
optionDescriptions.both_int8: 主干和文本编码器都 INT8。

standard_en.summary: Compression presets for the frozen base weights
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.off: No weight compression at load time.
optionDescriptions.experimental_float8: The backbone in FP8, leaning towards the 40 series, and experimental in flavour.
optionDescriptions.both_int8: Both the backbone and the text encoder in INT8.

advanced.principle: Krea-2 当前正式推荐使用这里选择冻结主干压缩方案。experimental_float8 对应 qfloat8 / torchao Float8 权重压缩：它只压冻结 DiT 主干权重，不会把 LoRA、text fusion 等可训练参数改成原生 FP8，数值更稳，也更符合当前低显存训练目标。

advanced_en.principle: Krea-2 currently formally recommends choosing the frozen-backbone compression scheme here. experimental_float8 corresponds to qfloat8 / torchao Float8 weight compression: it compresses only frozen DiT backbone weights and does not convert trainable parameters like LoRA or text fusion to native FP8, which is numerically steadier and better fits the current low-VRAM training goal.
